page_title: ATM 4-0 RSO | Atletico Madrid v Real Sociedad 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 59612.
90+2' Atl. Madrid earn a corner.

90+1' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
89' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
86' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Sanchez saw the whole situation.
85' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Substitution. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Alexander Sorloth.
74' It will be a substitution. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Rodrigo de Paul walks off.
73' Here is a change. Martin Zubimendi is going off and Imanol Alguacil gives the last tactical orders to Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
72' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Atl. Madrid was in an offside position.
68' The substitution is prepared. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giuliano Simeone.
68' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Samuel Lino is replaced by Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid).
67' The game is interrupted. Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
67' 5:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
61' It is time for a substitution. Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) is on for Luka Sucic.

58' The ball is laid off to Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the left side of the goal and forces Jan Oblak to make a decent save.
55' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pablo Barrios as he is replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
54' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gets a yellow card, off the field.
54' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Ander Barrenetxea will be replaced by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
53' Atl. Madrid are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
50' OFF THE BAR! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
46' Half-time substitution. Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) will not participate anymore and Arkaitz Mariezkurrena is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Imanol Alguacil decided to make a change. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is replaced by Igor Zubeldia.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Jose Sanchez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' A lofted pass into the box is met by Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad), who rifles a shot just over the bar.
45+2' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A clumsy foul by Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle.
44' Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but Jan Oblak punches the ball away.
44' That was close by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
39' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
35' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
33' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
30' 4 - 0 Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
29' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball but overhits it.
27' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
25' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) launches a cross from the corner, but Jan Oblak is alert to thwart the effort.

22' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot towards the bottom right corner. Unfortunately for him, Alex Remiro shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
20' Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
15' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
15' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
14' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
11' 3 - 0 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 3:0.
10' 2 - 0 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
9' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
8' A pass into the box finds Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alex Remiro denies him.
7' 1 - 0 Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) receives a delightful pass inside the box and fires the ball into the top right corner. What a lovely finish!
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jose Sanchez.
